summary: IMAP4rev2 lets an email client access and manage messages kept on a server, treating remote mailboxes like local folders. It includes creating, deleting and renaming mailboxes, checking for new messages, flags, searching and selective fetching, and it supports offline clients that resynchronize later. It does not cover sending mail, which is left to a submission protocol such as the one in RFC 6409.

eli5.summary: IMAP lets you read your email from any device while the messages stay on a big mail computer, like keeping your letters in a post office box. This is the newest version of those rules.

questions: how does imap access mailboxes on a server
